command: set -euo pipefail; docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.worker -t riccon-worker-ocr:o1b . ; tmp=$(mktemp -d); docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint cat riccon-worker-ocr:o1b /app/app.jar > "$tmp/app.jar"; unzip -l "$tmp/app.jar" > "$tmp/list.txt"; grep -q "com/riccon/worker/ocr/service/OcrCli.class" "$tmp/list.txt"; rm -rf "$tmp"; bash scripts/ops/ocr-check --image riccon-worker-ocr:o1b; git diff --check; grep -q "ocr-check --image riccon-worker-ocr:o1b" docs/RUNBOOK.md; node ~/.config/opencode/riccon/scripts/riccon.mjs contract validate --strict --project .; echo o1b-gate-ok
note: O1b gate：o1b 镜像重建 + jar 内 OcrCli + 零出网 ocr-check
